words.hint: say it in two beats — ex-CEL-lent — to catch both Ls
words.sentence: Her artwork was excellent and won first prize.
Scientists study the existence of life on other planets.

words.hint: there's a PLAN hidden inside: ex-PLAN-ation
words.sentence: She gave a clear explanation of how the machine worked.

words.hint: FAMILY is hidden at the start: famil-iar
words.sentence: The song sounded familiar, though I couldn't remember its name.

words.hint: breaks the i-before-e rule, like reign and neighbour
words.sentence: We visited a foreign country for the first time last summer.
The trader sold spices at the market every Saturday.
Good communication helps a team work well together.

words.hint: a voy-AGE takes an age — a long journey!
words.sentence: The ship set sail on a long voyage across the ocean.

words.hint: dis + aster — aster means star, so it's like a 'bad star'
words.sentence: The flood was a disaster for the whole village.
The team felt victorious after winning the final match.
